name: PT Maja Agung Latexindo Tbk
summary: PT Maja Agung Latexindo Tbk engages in the manufacture and sale of gloves in Indonesia. The company offers examination gloves, industrial gloves, and specialty gloves; and concentrated latex. It serves the medical and healthcare, industrial, and beauty care industries. The company also exports its products. PT Maja Agung Latexindo Tbk was founded in 1988 and is based in Deli Serdang, Indonesia.
